13953.note: Forever's own id 17143 is not in the item database, so Classic's unused 13953 lends the name and the icon.
13953.tooltip:
20 Mana
Melee Range
Instant
12 sec cooldown
Deals 40% weapon damage plus 36 to 46 Holy damage.

20059.note: Forever rebuilt Vengeance as a 5 stack buff worth 1% a stack for 30 sec, where Classic gave a flat 3% a point for 8 sec, and all three ranks read the same so points 2 and 3 add nothing.
20059.tooltip:
Landing a critical strike increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 1% for 30 sec.
Stacks up to 5 times.

20134.note: Forever moved the trigger from being crit to any melee attack that lands, and every rank reads the same 10% for 6%, so points 2 to 5 add nothing.
20134.tooltip:
Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 6%.
Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

assumptions: Rank 1's 10% absorb is used for all three ranks, so points 2 and 3 currently do nothing; ui/core/talents/trees/paladin.json reads 10/20/30%.
Rank 1's 33% chance for the mana return is used for all three ranks; ui/core/talents/trees/paladin.json reads 33/66/100%.
The 6% of maximum mana and the 3 second internal cooldown are rank 1's numbers, assumed flat across all three ranks.
20148.note: Forever bolted the mana return on block onto Classic's shield absorb, and the sim applies rank 1's numbers at every rank.
20148.tooltip:
Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 10%, and gives your blocks a 33% chance to restore 6% of your maximum Mana.
May only occur once every 3 sec.

20178.note: The crit half is Classic's 20% a point; Forever added the smaller 8% a point chance to fire off a block.
20178.tooltip: Gives you an 8% chance per talent point to gain an extra attack after blocking a melee attack, and a 20% chance per talent point to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike.

20216.note: sim/paladin/divine_favor.go is byte for byte upstream wowsims/classic - the 2 minute cooldown and the guaranteed crit are Classic's, and the sim spends it on Holy Shock only because Flash of Light and Holy Light are not modelled.

20914.note: Dead code: BlessingOfSanctuaryAura and its caller in applyBuffEffects are both commented out behind a 'TODO: Classic', so the sim never registers this id and the UI never resolves it.

25771.note: sim/paladin/forbearance.go is byte for byte upstream wowsims/classic; Forever's new Templar's Bulwark applies the same 1 minute Forbearance that Divine Shield and Divine Protection do.

25780.note: The aura still multiplies Holy threat by 1.6 exactly as in Classic; what Forever changed is the Improved Righteous Fury talent, which now cuts damage taken by 2% a point instead of raising that 1.6.

assumptions: The sim fires Vindication on every melee attack that lands; the tooltip says 'a chance' and never gives one, and the code still carries a TODO for the proc mask and chance.
The self buff reads 1% at every rank, so points 2 and 3 add nothing.
The 42 attack power the target loses is not modelled at all, because nothing in the sim reads an enemy's attack power.
26021.note: Forever added the 1% self attack power buff on top of Classic's attack power debuff, and the sim keeps the buff and drops the debuff.
26021.tooltip: Your damaging melee attacks have a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by 42 and to increase your Attack Power by 1% for 30 sec.

assumptions: Consecration is assumed to be baseline for every paladin: it is no longer a talent in the Forever tree, which builds on it through Consecrated Ground and Holy Conduit, but no spellbook has been seen.
The rank damage table, the 8 second cooldown and the 0.042 coefficient are Classic's and are assumed unchanged; only the mana cost moved, because Holy Conduit now discounts it 20% a point.
Consecrated Ground's buff is modelled as 5% Holy damage a point for 8 sec from the cast, and the tooltip's cap of the first 4 enemies a point to enter the Consecration is not modelled.
26573.note: 26573 is Consecration rank 1, and sim/paladin/talents.go:305 also hangs the Forever talent Consecrated Ground's buff aura on it, so Wowhead's Classic entry names Consecration and describes neither the Forever spell nor the talent buff.
26573.tooltip:
135 Mana
Instant
8 sec cooldown
Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 64 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area.

assumptions: Only rank 1's 5% threat was seen; ranks 2 to 5 are assumed to scale linearly to 25%.
Only rank 1's 2% damage taken was seen; ranks 2 to 5 are assumed to scale linearly to 10%, with the 6 second duration flat at every rank.
The damage reduction is assumed to need Righteous Fury active; the sim registers no aura at all when it is off.
31850.note: Iron Creed is new in Forever and has no spell of its own in the database, so Ardent Defender's id 31850 stands in for the buff and Classic's data answers to it with nothing at all.
31850.tooltip:
Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability by 5% per talent point.
While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by 2% per talent point for 6 sec.

31876.note: 31876 is the Burning Crusade Sanctified Judgement, which Classic's database does not carry, so nothing resolves for it and the sim uses it only to label the mana the talent returns.
31876.tooltip: Gives your Judgement ability a 33% chance per talent point to return 20% per talent point of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

assumptions: The tooltip carries no cooldown; the 5 minutes is assumed from the two Forbearance abilities Sacred Duty shortens alongside it.
Both ranks of Sacred Duty read 30 sec off the cooldown, so rank 2 is assumed to be another 30 sec.
The sim has no absorb model, so the shield is modelled as damage taken dropping to 1% for the whole 8 seconds rather than as a pool that can be spent early.
53601.note: Templar's Bulwark is new in Forever and borrows Sacred Shield's id 53601, the paladin absorb the tooltip describes, which Classic's database does not carry.
53601.tooltip:
Instant
5 min cooldown
Grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec.
Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

assumptions: The tooltip carries no cooldown; the 1 minute is assumed, long enough that it buys one extra Judgement rather than a second rotation.
53671.note: Swift Judgement is new in Forever and borrows Judgements of the Pure's id 53671, which Classic's database does not carry.
53671.tooltip:
Instant
1 min cooldown
Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.

77485.note: Twist of Light is new in Forever and borrows Echo of Light's id 77485, which Classic's database does not carry; only Seal of Righteousness and Seal of Command bank an Echo here, because the other two seals are not in the sim and Seal of the Crusader has no on-hit proc to echo.
77485.tooltip:
When you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, gain an Echo.
Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.
